jobs.prompt: Two fixes on this branch (it was just merged with origin/main, which brought the guard free-text rule ids and tokens). (1) tests/guard-change-preview.test.mjs test swarm change --yes is refused with handbuild-change-record rule id now fails after the merge: reconcile the refusal text of the new rule with main refusal format (rule id AND matched token named, see tools/self-approval.mjs and tools/shell-writes.mjs and tests/guard-free-text.test.mjs): the --yes recording from an agent session stays refused, a preview without --yes stays allowed; fix the test or the code so both hold and both guard-change-preview and guard-free-text tests pass. (2) Real bug found live: the board server record written by tools/watch-cli.mjs has version null (installedVersionFor depends on SWARM_INSTALL_DIR in the environment, which is normally unset), so swarm update reports board server record skipped: missing version in board server record and never restarts the board. Fix: the record version is the version of the RUNNING runner: use runnerVersion(import.meta.url) from tools/runner-version.mjs (already on main) and fall back to the install package.json; never null for a server started by a swarm runner. Same for the remote serve record (tools/remote.mjs or wherever it registers). Also make tools/server-restart.mjs treat a record with a missing version as restartable when its pid identity verifies (version unknown means older than any target), instead of skipping it. Tests in tests/server-record-version.test.mjs: a started board record has a string version equal to the runner version with no SWARM_INSTALL_DIR set; a record with a null version and a verified pid is restarted by restartRegisteredServers; a record whose pid identity does not verify is still not signalled. Keep tests/server-restart-round2.test.mjs, round3, round4, tests/update-when-idle.test.mjs and every test file with server-restart or watch-cli in the name passing. ignoreTests reason: only the named files and their tests change.
